**Paris Get‑Away Itinerary (7 Days)** *(Feel free to swap days or add extra activities based on your interests.)* | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation** | • Arrive at Charles de Gaulle or Orly.
• Take the RER B or a taxi to your hotel in the 7th or 8th arrondissement.
• Check‑in and freshen up. | • Walk along the Seine to the **Eiffel Tower**; enjoy the view from the Champ‑de‑Mars.
• Grab a light lunch at a nearby café (e.g., **Café Constant**). | • Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (reservation recommended) or a classic bistro like **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon**.
• Night stroll across the Seine to see the Eiffel Tower sparkle. | | **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | • Breakfast at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près).
• Visit **Notre‑Dame** (exterior only, interior closed for restoration). | • Walk to **Sainte‑Chapelle** (book tickets in advance).
• Lunch in the Latin Quarter (try **Le Coupe‑Coupe**). | • Explore the **Latin Quarter** nightlife or enjoy a river cruise on the Seine (e.g., **Bateaux Mouches**). | | **Day 3 – Art & Culture** | • Early visit to the **Louvre** (skip‑the‑line tickets).
• Coffee break at **Café Marly** overlooking the pyramid. | • Lunch at **Le Fumoir** (near the Louvre).
• Visit **Musée d’Orsay** (focus on Impressionism). | • Dinner at **Septime** (reservations essential) or a cozy spot like **Le Petit Cler**. | | **Day 4 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur** | • Breakfast at **Le Pain Quotidien**.
• Take the funicular or walk up to **Sacré‑Coeur**; enjoy panoramic views. | • Explore **Place du Tertre**, visit art studios, and have lunch at **La Maison Rose**.
• Optional: visit the **Moulin Rouge** backstage tour. | • Dinner at **Le Coq Rico** (famous for poultry) or a wine bar like **Le Baratin**. | | **Day 5 – Day Trip** | • Take a train to **Versailles** (RER C).
• Tour the **Palace** and **Gardens** (guided audio tour). | • Picnic lunch in the gardens or lunch at **La Petite Venise**.
• Return to Paris in the late afternoon. | • Light dinner near your hotel; perhaps try **L’Avant‑Garde** for modern French cuisine. | | **Day 6 – Shopping & Relaxation** | • Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées**.
• Stroll down **Champs‑Élysées**; shop at flagship stores. | • Lunch at **Ladurée** for macarons and tea.
• Visit the **Arc de Triomphe** (climb to the top). | • Sunset dinner at **Le Cinq** (if you’re feeling extravagant) or a relaxed meal at **Chez L’Ami Jean**. | | **Day 7 – Departure** | • Pack and check‑out.
• Quick breakfast at **Café du Monde** (not the New Orleans one, but a charming Parisian spot). | • Last‑minute souvenir shopping at **Galeries Lafayette** or **Printemps**. | • Head to the airport; consider a farewell drink at **Le Perchoir** rooftop bar if time allows. | --- ### Practical Tips | Topic | Recommendation | |-------|----------------| | **Transport** | Buy a **Paris Visite** pass (zones 1‑3) for unlimited metro/bus/RER rides. For day trips, consider a **Renfe‑SNCF** combo ticket. | | **Accommodation** | Stay central (7th, 8th, or 1st arrondissement) for easy access to major sights. Hotels like **Hotel Le Meurice** or boutique options such as **Hotel Henriette** offer great value. | | **Dining** | Book reservations 2–3 weeks ahead for popular restaurants. Try local specialties: croissants, escargot, coq au vin, and crème brûlée. | | **Tickets** | Use the official museum websites for skip‑the‑line tickets. For the Eiffel Tower, book the **“Skip‑the‑Line”** option online. | | **Language** | Basic French phrases help: “Bonjour”, “Merci”, “Où est…?”, “Combien ça coûte?”. | | **Safety** | Keep valuables secure; pickpocketing can happen in crowded areas. | | **Weather** | Pack layers; Paris weather can be unpredictable. Bring an umbrella and comfortable walking shoes. | --- ### Optional Add‑Ons - **Wine Tasting**: Join a guided tasting at **La Cave à Michel**. - **Cooking Class**: Book a French pastry workshop at **Le Cordon‑Bleu**. - **Nightlife**: Explore the **Marais** bars or a jazz club like **Le Caveau de la Huchette**. Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like a more tailored plan (budget, interests, dates), just let me know.
